text:
Elaine (Growth): Quick idea — run a 48h search burst + dynamic creative rotation focused on developer buyers. Objective: drop CPA on free trials and capture which headline hooks lift CVR for engineers. Need ops + creative support.

Miguel (Mktg Ops): budget? geo? bidding? any exclusions?

Elaine (Growth): Budget = $20k over 48h. Geo: NA + EU (English). Bid: target CPA $45, tCPA automated with manual override. Exclude existing trialers and current demo pipeline. Landing page: /signup-trial-longform with variant for messaging. UTM: ?utm_campaign=dev_burst_48h&utm_source=search_dynamic

Samir (Paid Ads): I can spin the campaigns. Will use DSAs + expanded text for search keywords + responsive search ads for dynamic headline swaps. Need creative assets & final headlines by EOD tomorrow. Also should we enable dynamic remarketing audience for churned trialers?

Tara (Design): I can deliver 4 headline variants and 4 descriptions. Do we want image assets for GDN/YouTube follow-up or just text for now?

Elaine (Growth): Start with text for search, then retarget with display if early signals look good. No new images for the burst — keep speed. Headlines we want to test (drafts below):

Elaine (Growth): ```
H1: Run inference at predictable cost
H2: Ship LLM features with low latency
H3: Cut per-token costs for production
H4: Switch models without downtime
Description variants:
D1: Fast, reliable LLM serving for engineering teams. Try Redwood free.
D2: Predictable pricing + dedicated capacity for production workloads.
D3: Reduce inference cost with batching and caching. Start a trial.
```

Samir (Paid Ads): Nice. Will set up RSA with those as headline permutations. I'll add keyword groups: dev infra, LLM inference, low-latency inference, model serving. Also exclude "tutorial" terms to avoid education queries.

Jess (Analytics): Measurement plan: primary = CPA on trial signups; secondary = demo requests, demo-to-trial conversion, avg session duration. Create a test label and use incremental holdout (10% control) for attribution. Add tags for creative variant (H1..H4) so we can segment CVR by headline.

Miguel (Mktg Ops): For inbound routing: route trial signups from this burst to SDR queue "Growth-Demo-Burst" and mark lead source as search_dynamic_burst_48h. Make sure Outreach sequence is paused for the first 24h to avoid double touches.

Elaine (Growth): Good call. Also: please exclude audiences with >1 trial in last 12 months. Samir — can you set retargeting to only start 6 hours after first click so we don't overlap the search conversion window?

Samir (Paid Ads): Yep — retargeting window = 6h after click, frequency cap 3/day. Exclusions set for trialers.

Tara (Design): Quick ask — should descriptions reference "dedicated capacity" or keep generic "production-ready" phrasing?

Elaine (Growth): Use both across variants. One set that emphasizes dedicated capacity (enterprise-facing) and one set that emphasizes speed & cost (developer-facing). We'll see which resonates.

campaign-bot: Campaign draft created: dev_burst_48h | budget 20,000 | regions: NA,EU | start: 1772016000 | end: 1772198400 | status: DRAFT

Jess (Analytics): Add event tracking snippet for signup page: make sure `signup.source` contains utm_campaign and creative_id. I'll wire up a quick Looker dashboard tile for H1..H4 CVR by hour so we can make pausing decisions fast.

Miguel (Mktg Ops): Timeline check — Tagging, audience exclusions, and inbound routing config to be done by tomorrow 3pm PT. Samir will launch once creatives are wired and QA passes.

Samir (Paid Ads): QA checklist: landing conv pixel, exclude lists, ad copy approvals, URL params, GA test conversion. I'll post the ad previews here before launch.

Elaine (Growth): Perfect. If we see CPA > $80 after first 12h, pause broad match and tighten match types. If H1 outperforms by >20% CVR vs baseline, scale budget +30% for the remaining window.

Tara (Design): I'll drop final headline/description CSV here by 11am tomorrow.

Elaine (Growth): Thanks all — tagging @Miguel (Mktg Ops) @Samir (Paid Ads) for follow-ups. :rocket:

Miguel (Mktg Ops): 👍 will update the campaign doc and confirm once routing is set.
